nl_Literal_translation_en: From 1 to 5 seconds from now, the throttle command shall remain below 30 percent.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 5 秒之间，油门指令应始终低于 30%。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the traction-control window from the first through the fifth second, the commanded throttle shall continuously remain below 30 percent.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 1 秒至第 5 秒的牵引力控制窗口内，油门指令应持续保持在 30% 以下。
